_comment: This repo IS the AI template. is_template makes guard-template-sync a no-op here (ADR-002 decision 5) — there is no template above this one to sync to. Projects generated via new-project.py get a config.json WITHOUT this flag (create_config_json builds from config.json.example).
_template_update_check_comment: ADR-006 decision 8: projects with a local clone of this template read this switch from its released main and, when true, say at session start what waits for them (python3 scripts/update-from-template.py).
_stack_commands_comment: To repo jest pythonowe, ale ma package.json (doctor + setup-hooks), wiec autodetekcja stacku wybiera node i guardy szukaja npm run lint/test, ktorych nie ma. Bez tego override kazdy commit lokalny jest blokowany.
